spec.name: M5.OrderBoundary.range_card
spec.statement: ∀ (S : Finset ℕ) (N : ℕ), (∀ e ∈ S, e < N) → S.card ≤ N
spec.guidance: Prove S subset Finset.range N, apply Finset.card_le_card and Finset.card_range. Return only tactic lines without leading by; preserve exact target.

spec.name: M5.OrderBoundary.signature_lower_bounds
spec.statement: ∀ (N w : ℕ) (F : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (A B : Finset ℕ), F.Monic → F.coeff 0 = 1 → M5.PhysicalOrder.realizes N w F A B → M5.signaturePeriod F ∣ N ∧ w ≤ N ∧ F.natDegree < N
spec.guidance: Unfold realizes. Complete signature divides cyclicModulus N and ofSupport A via EuclideanDomain.gcd_dvd_left/right; rewrite its equality to F. M5.Period.period_law gives period divisibility. range_card gives weight bound. support_degree_bound at N gives deg a<N, and a nonzero from coeff0=1 using support_coeff_zero. Polynomial.natDegree_le_of_dvd bounds deg F by deg a. Use explicit gcd arguments. Return only tactic lines without leading by; preserve exact target.

spec.name: M5.OrderBoundary.weight_one_iff
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (F : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (A B : Finset ℕ), M5.PhysicalOrder.realizes N 1 F A B ↔ N = 1 ∧ F = 1 ∧ A = {0} ∧ B = {0}
spec.guidance: Unfold realizes. Cardinality1 and zero membership force both supports={0} using Finset.card_eq_one or eq_singleton_iff_unique_mem. Each polynomial=1. Their integer gcd is0 so supportGcd N {0} {0}=N; connectivity forces N=1. EuclideanDomain gcd of1 gives complete signature1. Reverse substitute N=F=1 and A=B={0}, unfold and simplify. No assumption w>=2; this is the source weight-one boundary. Return only tactic lines without leading by; preserve exact target.
